entities.summary: Jiuta Naqoli Wainiqolo is a Fijian rugby union player who currently plays for Lyon Olympique Universitaire (LOU) in the Top 14 competition in France and for the Flying Fijians 15s and 7s teams. During the 2020 Summer Olympics, he was a member of Fiji's Men's Rugby 7s team, which won the gold medal.
